name: Fyxer
description: Ask questions across your inbox and meeting notes to surface action items, decisions, and key discussions. Pull up meeting summaries and transcripts. Describe what you want to say and get a reply drafted in your voice, ready to send.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Fyxer to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Fyxer to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://app.fyxer.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Fyxer MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Fyxer provides these MCP tools: search_context, find_recordings, search_meetings, get_recording, get_meeting, get_transcript, draft_email, and resolve_person.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Fyxer?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Fyxer in communication on the Manufact MCP catalog include AgentLine: Phone Numbers for AI Agents, JooVoice, OpenMail, Granola, and Fleet Connected Apps.
Fyxer requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Fyxer is developed by Fyxer. It is listed as partner on the Claude connector directory.
